result_text:
The region manager's open-ticket list now sorts high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. It matches the sales-rep list.

The change is one query in `DataStore.listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 10021). It now uses the same `ORDER BY CASE t.priority …` clause as `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep`, and I updated the Javadoc to match. The filters are unchanged, so closed tickets and other regions are still excluded.

`mvn -o test` passes: 607 tests, 0 failures. I did not add a test for the new order. Nothing is committed.
